about.title: About Guillaume - Emergency Operations Consultant
about.subtitle: Specialist in interim executive replacement for critical situations
about.description: Emergency operations consultant, I take command when the situation becomes uncontrollable. Pragmatic and results-oriented, I turn around struggling startups and scaleups.

timeline.title: Co-CEO & Co-Founder - Ligerio
timeline.description: Leader in online sales of distinctive floor and wall coverings in France. From €0 to €10M turnover in 4 years. Exceptional growth: 50% to 100% per year for 3 consecutive years. Operational efficiency: logistics flow x20 in 3 years without increasing staff.

timeline.title: CFO - SecurClés
timeline.description: Financial management of a tech company specialized in remote key reproduction with patented technology. Complete restructuring of financial processes and implementation of robust internal controls.

timeline.title: VP Finance - Orami (WhatsNew Group)
timeline.description: Financial management of the e-commerce group based in Thailand, parent company of several brands (Petloft, Orami, Sanoga, Lafema, MOXY).

timeline.title: Group CFO - Glossybox (Rocket Internet)
timeline.description: Financial management of a Rocket Internet success story. Consolidated turnover: €70M, active in 8 countries. Management of due diligence and acquisition by The Hut Group.

timeline.title: Senior Executive Finance Manager - Jumia
timeline.description: SWAT missions in high-risk African countries. Financial restructuring, legal compliance and AAA team training. 22 companies, 550 employees under supervision.

timeline.title: Head of Finance - Groupe Lactalis Kazakhstan
timeline.description: Modernization of kolkhoz finances. 9 divisions, 380 employees, financial division of 25 people. Complete restructuring and restoration of governance.

testimonials.title: Client testimonials
testimonials.subtitle: They trust us for their growth and challenges

items.name: Francis D.
items.content: Guillaume has supported us through many complex situations (tax audits, sudden executive departures, management embezzlement suspicions, etc.). He is very effective, knows how to dive deep into details while maintaining a holistic view. I highly recommend him.

items.name: Foucauld P.
items.content: Thanks to Guillaume, we structured our finance in 3 months and raised €2M. His part-time CFO expertise allowed us to maintain control while accelerating our growth. A trusted partner.

items.name: Clément F.
items.content: In crisis situation, Guillaume took command immediately. He implemented ZOHO CRM and restructured our processes. His ability to stabilize operations and reassure teams saved our company. A true 'emergency' consultant.

items.name: Caren G.
items.content: We mandated Guillaume during the sale of our company Glossybox (€70M revenue). The sale was blocked due to the quality of our financial data. Guillaume restructured the entire group (5 countries), brought everything into compliance with IFRS standards. He also supported us during a tax audit on our holding company. The sale was finalized 8 months after his arrival.

items.name: Rolland D.
items.content: Guillaume completely restructured our operations. From cash management to process optimization, he transformed our company. An exceptional professional.

items.name: Jeremy F.
items.content: His scaling expertise allowed us to grow from 10 to 100 employees without losing control. Guillaume knows how to anticipate growth challenges and implement the right tools.
